zh-CN.A plywood desk is a satisfying, quick bu: 先把项目尺寸、零件数量、材料类型和可见面要求写清楚。CutList 只有拿到真实约束，才能生成可以落地的板材排版。
zh-CN.A common desk height is about 29-30 inch: 输入实际板材尺寸、锯缝、纹理方向和是否允许旋转。对个人项目来说，提前把这些参数设准，比开锯后返工更省时间。
zh-CN.The top is a plywood panel, often with a: 生成方案后不要只看利用率，还要检查窄条、余料、切割顺序和容易混淆的重复零件。可视化布局是开工前的最后审核点。
zh-CN.For a 48-inch desk in 3/4-inch plywood:: 把项目保存到历史记录，必要时导出 PDF 或打印切割清单。完成后对比实际余料，下次类似项目会规划得更准。
zh-CN.A shallow drawer under the top or an ope: A shallow drawer under the top or an open shelf adds function. Build the drawer as a small box on slides, or fix a shelf between the supports. Plan these parts into the cut list. Keep the drawer shallow so knees still fit; comfort beats maximizing storage in a desk.
zh-CN.Set the height to your chair and comfort: 确认所有零件名称和数量。
zh-CN.Use a plywood top with a banded or doubl: 设置真实板材尺寸与锯缝。
zh-CN.Choose end panels, trestle, or legs for: 检查纹理方向和可见面。
zh-CN.Add a stretcher or modesty panel for rig: 保存或导出最终切割方案。
Keep any drawer shallow for knee room.
